what: A fine grid filling the element (cells around 40px — element width divided by the rounded cell count) is drawn with a WebGL shader, and noise flowing slowly at .05 times time pushes the grid diagonally by up to .075 of the element size. It ripples harder from the edges toward the center, and with outline the outer border cells stay straight, standing like a frame. Line color is the element’s color (default --kf-line)

options.cell: Cell size basis (px), default 40 — cell count = round(width/cell)
options.amp: Wobble strength (ratio to element size), default .075
options.outline: true keeps the outer border straight (Hero · Footer frames). Default false — no edge line, sits flush against the panel (decoration beside lists)
